verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official MCP server (mcp.ramp.com) plus CLI agent mode, both explicitly enabling natural-language operation (query balances, approve requests, lock cards, run spend analysis) via ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor, with documented examples like 'Lock my card' and 'Show me our top software vendors by spend this quarter.' This is corroborated by live probes confirming the MCP server is real, OAuth-gated, and scoped. missing for 10: independent/third-party hands-on reviews of natural-language usage quality beyond vendor docs and self-probes, and some gaps remain (e.g., bill approvals not yet available via MCP).
